newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- KeyCorp estimate revised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- KeyCorp estimate revised.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said on Tuesday it revised its earnings estimate for KeyCorp in fiscal 1997 after the commercial banking company announced a major restructuring program.
-- EVEREN said KeyCorp's plan to sell 140 retail bank branches and eliminate 2,700 jobs, along with a stock repurchase program, will add $0.20 to its original fiscal 1997 estimate of $4.15 per share.
-- A charge of $100 million will reduce fourth-quarter net income by $ 0.30 per share after taxes, said EVEREN.
-- KeyCorp stock was down 3/8 at 50-7/8 in midafternoon exchange trading.
